scope: Independent review of local integration build; no declaration that every page/module/workflow is finished

modules.name: Tenant & provisioning
modules.required_responsibilities: Tenant lifecycle, plan region, isolation tier, data ownership, migrations
modules.remaining_work: Tenant rows/screens are fixtures; real provisioning, tenant binding, isolation and lifecycle services are absent.

modules.name: Organization & branches
modules.required_responsibilities: Legal entity, business registration, branches, locations, store hours, business dates
modules.remaining_work: Typed company/branch records exist; company-aware authorization, hierarchy constraints, timezone/business-date handling remain incomplete.

modules.name: Identity & staff
modules.required_responsibilities: Invitations, staff, memberships, MFA, session/device revocation
modules.remaining_work: Local passwords/sessions and staff access edits exist; OIDC, invitations, MFA, step-up and recovery are absent.

modules.name: RBAC / ABAC policy
modules.required_responsibilities: Roles, permission bundles, branch scoping, maker-checker, separation of duties
modules.required_outputs: Effective capabilities API, authorization decisions, audit
modules.remaining_work: Fixed local roles and branch/customer filters exist; dynamic policy, ABAC, company isolation and complete command authorization matrix remain incomplete.

modules.name: Subscriptions & billing
modules.required_responsibilities: Plan, features, seats, branch allowances, invoices to merchant, payment collection
modules.remaining_work: Subscription forms are not merchant billing, metering, entitlement enforcement or provider-backed collection.

modules.name: Catalog / PIM
modules.required_responsibilities: SKU, product variants, brand, category, barcodes, media, lifecycle
modules.remaining_work: Product/category typed CRUD exists; variant/media lifecycle, production search and complete import validation remain incomplete.

modules.name: Units & measurement
modules.required_responsibilities: Base UoM, conversion ratios, pack definitions, tare, precision
modules.required_outputs: Conversion tests and preview, UoM APIs
modules.remaining_work: Unit/pack fields exist; exact rational conversions, tare, precision and effective historical UoM contracts lack full tests.

modules.name: Pricing & promotions
modules.required_responsibilities: Retail/wholesale tiers, effective dates, customer/branch prices, discounts
modules.remaining_work: Price fields and cashier override protection exist; full tier/promotional/effective-date quote engine is absent.

modules.name: Inventory authority
modules.required_responsibilities: Custody, ownership/valuation positions, immutable movements, central reservations, exclusive offline stock grants
modules.required_outputs: Sole inventory writer; physical/owned/available balances and §32/§33 contracts
modules.remaining_work: Agent implements transactional stock helper; full immutable ownership/custody/reservation/valuation authority and production concurrency remain incomplete.

modules.name: Stock count & replenishment
modules.required_responsibilities: Cycle count, blind counts, approval, reorder points, transfer suggestions
modules.remaining_work: Agent implements count adjustments; blind count sessions, replenishment and complete approval/variance rules remain incomplete.

modules.name: Warehousing & transfers
modules.required_responsibilities: Bins, receiving, dispatch, in-transit, cross-branch transfer acknowledgements
modules.required_outputs: Transfer commands, scans, delivery and loss records
modules.remaining_work: Agent implements dispatch/receipt/transit workflows; full scan, loss, partial transfer and company boundaries need evidence.

modules.name: Supplier master
modules.required_responsibilities: Supplier identity, purchasing terms, contact, documents, tax data
modules.remaining_work: Supplier forms exist; document bytes, duplicate screening and production supplier lifecycle remain incomplete.

modules.name: Procurement
modules.required_responsibilities: Requisitions, RFQ, purchase orders, approvals, partial receipt, returns
modules.remaining_work: Agent implements receipt posting; full requisition/RFQ, toleranced three-way matching, landed-cost adjustments and AP reconciliation remain incomplete.

modules.name: Supplier accounts
modules.required_responsibilities: Payables, credit notes, deposits, payment allocation, ageing
modules.remaining_work: Agent implements supplier allocation/journal paths; complete AP ageing, credit notes and provider payout workflows remain incomplete.

modules.name: Customer master
modules.required_responsibilities: Customer identity, optional business KYC, consent, terms, contacts
modules.required_outputs: Directory, merge with audit, branch visibility
modules.remaining_work: Customer CRUD/scoping exists; consent, merge audit and complete identity/terms controls remain incomplete.

modules.name: Customer credit/deposits
modules.required_responsibilities: AR ledger, credit limits, deposit liability, invoice allocations, refunds
modules.remaining_work: Agent implements protected deposit allocation/refund and credit effects; complete credit policy and reconciliation scenario coverage remain incomplete.

modules.name: POS & sales
modules.required_responsibilities: Cart/held sale, price and tax snapshot, receipt, sale approval, stock issue
modules.remaining_work: POS drafts, lines and local sale posting exist; full price/tax/rounding/recognition/atomic issuance and production ledger guarantees remain incomplete.

modules.name: Payments and settlement
modules.required_responsibilities: Tender types, provider adapters, settlement events, refunds, chargebacks
modules.remaining_work: MTN implementation and mocked contract tests in progress; no live credentials/approval. Orange merchant API contract and credentials are unavailable. No live payment certification.

modules.name: Cash management
modules.required_responsibilities: Cash registers, shifts, movements, count, closing and differences
modules.remaining_work: Agent implements cash entries/closure; full gross tender/change, open-shift enforcement and reconciliation coverage remain incomplete.

modules.name: Expenses
modules.required_responsibilities: Expense categories, payees, receipts, approvals, posted cash/bank impact
modules.remaining_work: Expense records exist; complete approval and cash/bank journal effects need implementation and evidence.

modules.name: Quotations & offers
modules.required_responsibilities: Draft/issued quotes, expiry, revisions, approval, customer acceptance
modules.required_outputs: Quote APIs, document and POS staging
modules.remaining_work: Quotation records/documents exist; agent may implement conversion; expiry, revisions and independently tested issued quote rules remain incomplete.

modules.name: Returns & credit notes
modules.required_responsibilities: Original sale eligibility, inspection, restocking, credits, customer refund
modules.required_outputs: Return API, credit note, refund voucher
modules.remaining_work: Agents coordinate financial credit and restock; warranties, exchanges, original component eligibility and real provider refunds remain incomplete.

modules.name: Fulfillment & delivery
modules.required_responsibilities: Pickup, packing, shipping, drivers, proof of delivery, partial fulfillment
modules.remaining_work: Agent implements custody pickup/handover; shipping/driver/POD attachment and full partial recognition scenarios remain incomplete.

modules.name: Document & print engine
modules.required_responsibilities: Atomic document issuance, number series, immutable economic snapshots, template versions and print attempts
modules.required_outputs: issueSnapshot in source transaction; rendering/download/print after commit (§38)
modules.remaining_work: 26 document views and server snapshots exist; atomic economic issuance/numbering, tamper-evident retention, bilingual print and device certification are absent.

modules.name: Fiscal configuration & operational journal
modules.required_responsibilities: Balanced control journal, company account mappings, periods, tax rules, finance export and fiscal adapter policy
modules.required_outputs: postBatch, reversal, control reconciliation, tax preview and accountant exports (§37)
modules.remaining_work: Agent implements balanced local journals/period gates; SYSCOHADA mappings, comprehensive reversal/valuation/tax/fiscal integration and accountant signoff remain absent.

modules.name: Operational reporting
modules.required_responsibilities: Sales KPIs, margin estimates, stock, AR/AP, expenses, cash, audit
modules.required_outputs: Bounded aggregate views, exports, report jobs
modules.remaining_work: 76 report views render; several are source-row approximations. Exact metric contracts, scoped pagination/jobs, totals and reconciliation coverage remain incomplete.

modules.name: Commerce storefront
modules.required_responsibilities: Storefront products, prices, checkout, customer cart and delivery choices
modules.remaining_work: Storefront screens use shared shell/fixtures; actual public tenant storefront, SSR/SEO, cart privacy and delivery/pricing pipeline are absent.

modules.name: Orders & reservation orchestration
modules.required_responsibilities: Multi-channel orders and reservation workflow; M09 alone owns reservation quantities/tables
modules.required_outputs: Order API; invoke inventory reserve/release/consume; order expiry and compensation coordination
modules.remaining_work: Order forms exist; inventory-owned timed reservations, expiry compensation and verified payment-to-fulfillment choreography remain incomplete.

modules.name: Offline mobile/sync
modules.required_responsibilities: Device grant, local outbox, batch push, deltas, conflicts, high-watermarks
modules.remaining_work: No native durable outbox/inbox, commit-safe feed/snapshot, signed device epochs, exclusive grant protocol or outage/chaos evidence.

modules.name: Windows bridge & standalone companion
modules.required_responsibilities: WPF adapter, source mappings, encrypted companion snapshots/drafts and native reconciliation
modules.required_outputs: Reuse M29 sync protocol; no alternate cloud sync engine or direct DB copying (§35/§38)
modules.remaining_work: Actual Windows source and native build/test environment unavailable; no certified WPF bridge or standalone companion implementation.

modules.name: Notifications & alerts
modules.required_responsibilities: Event-driven email/SMS/push/WhatsApp templates, preferences, delivery receipts
modules.remaining_work: No configured email/SMS/push/WhatsApp provider, queue, templates/preferences/delivery receipt implementation.

modules.name: Integrations & webhooks
modules.required_responsibilities: Provider configuration, secrets, signed webhooks, retries, sandbox/test mode
modules.remaining_work: Mobile-money agent adds provider boundary; comprehensive secret rotation, signed webhook framework, retry workers and health probes absent.

modules.name: Import / export / migration
modules.required_responsibilities: CSV/XLSX templates, dry-run diff, duplicate handling, mapping, job audit
modules.required_outputs: Import jobs, scoped exports, failure manifest
modules.remaining_work: Operations agent adds CSV dry-run/commit; XLSX, historical mapping, scoped export jobs and full migration rollback evidence absent.

modules.name: Audit & compliance
modules.required_responsibilities: Immutable event trail, retention policy, access logs, legal hold, export
modules.remaining_work: Local audit table exists; immutable append-only controls, retention/legal hold, operational access log coverage and deletion execution absent.

modules.name: Platform administration
modules.required_responsibilities: Tenant support, service health, billing support, capacity, feature rollout
modules.remaining_work: Platform-admin role/screens exist but no separate control plane, provisioning, feature rollout, billing support or break-glass workflow.

modules.name: Industry capabilities
modules.required_responsibilities: Per-vertical attributes, templates, sector rules and optional module packages
modules.required_outputs: Feature and schema configuration, not tenant code forks
modules.remaining_work: Industry fields/screens exist; no full signed enablement/migrations, second-industry and regulatory test evidence.

modules.name: Device and print management
modules.required_responsibilities: Registered printers/scanners, locale/templates, device status and troubleshooting
modules.remaining_work: Printer/scanner profiles exist; actual discovery, drivers, signing/certificates and thermal/A4 hardware certification unavailable.

modules.name: Data lifecycle & backup
modules.required_responsibilities: Tenant export, deletion workflows, PITR runbooks, restore verification
modules.remaining_work: Operations agent adds validated local backup/restore; tenant-selective PITR, offsite encryption, retention/hold replay and disaster recovery evidence absent.

modules.name: Search and indexing
modules.required_responsibilities: Product/customer/supplier search, autocomplete, bounded reindexing
modules.required_outputs: PostgreSQL full text initially; external index only if needed
modules.remaining_work: In-memory/browser substring filters exist; bounded production search/indexing, scope-safe suggestions and reindex jobs absent.

modules.name: Support & diagnostics
modules.required_responsibilities: Ticket, diagnostic bundle, consented remote support session, incident linking
modules.required_outputs: Support UI and auditable access grant
modules.remaining_work: Support/incident forms exist; consented timed access grants, diagnostics redaction, operational incident playbooks and evidence absent.

modules.name: Inventory authority
modules.required_responsibilities: Item/location balances, immutable movement journal, reservations, quarantine
modules.remaining_work: Agent implements transactional stock helper; full immutable ownership/custody/reservation/valuation authority and production concurrency remain incomplete.

modules.name: Document & print engine
modules.required_responsibilities: Immutable snapshots, receipts, invoices, notes, template versions, print attempts
modules.remaining_work: 26 document views and server snapshots exist; atomic economic issuance/numbering, tamper-evident retention, bilingual print and device certification are absent.

modules.name: Fiscal & accounting configuration
modules.required_responsibilities: Tax rates, invoice-series policy, configurable fiscal adapters, posting mappings
modules.required_outputs: Tax policy preview, finance exports, audit snapshots
modules.remaining_work: Agent implements balanced local journals/period gates; SYSCOHADA mappings, comprehensive reversal/valuation/tax/fiscal integration and accountant signoff remain absent.

modules.name: Orders & reservations
modules.required_responsibilities: Multi-channel order state, stock holds, expiry, capture and cancellations
modules.required_outputs: Order API, reservation events and expiry
modules.remaining_work: Order forms exist; inventory-owned timed reservations, expiry compensation and verified payment-to-fulfillment choreography remain incomplete.

modules.name: Windows bridge
modules.required_responsibilities: WPF operation mappings, site registration, local idempotency, reconciliation
modules.required_outputs: Versioned desktop sync contract; no direct DB copying
modules.remaining_work: Actual Windows source and native build/test environment unavailable; no certified WPF bridge or standalone companion implementation.

audit_findings.title: Snapshot metadata scope
audit_findings.required_outcome: Owner-generated labels/product units must be filtered for current reader; nested data must not reuse creator permissions.
audit_findings.state: Fixed in current source; negative API test PASS

audit_findings.title: Approval payload mutation
audit_findings.required_outcome: Approved/In review records and lines cannot be modified without a controlled revision invalidating approval.
audit_findings.state: Fixed in current source; both approved-field and approved-line negative API tests PASS

audit_findings.title: Generic business status transitions
audit_findings.required_outcome: Business commands require per-entity behavior and invariants; unsupported commands fail without status mutation.
audit_findings.state: Restricted in current source; unsupported role publish negative API test PASS; full per-entity matrix still needs review

audit_findings.title: Derived balance edits
audit_findings.required_outcome: Protect allocated/collected/consumed/expected amounts from generic edits, including imports; freeze economically active rows.

audit_findings.title: Tenant/company authority
audit_findings.required_outcome: Do not accept hardcoded demo tenant/company as multi-tenant isolation; bind identity to memberships and enforce all query/write/document paths.

audit_findings.title: Money wire and rounding contract
audit_findings.required_outcome: Architecture requires integral XAF and exact string/rational contracts; decimal acceptance and Number formatting need explicit validation/rounding tests.

audit_findings.title: Canonical replay and transactional events
audit_findings.required_outcome: Current user+operation_id cache is not canonical cross-device/company operation identity; durable transactional outbox/inbox and reconstruction absent.

audit_findings.title: Static file allowlist
audit_findings.required_outcome: Normalize/decode paths before authorization; serve only known public roots so encoded paths cannot expose future sensitive static extensions.

audit_findings.title: Integration state is not activation
audit_findings.required_outcome: Enabled/Active fields must not imply provider, identity, DNS, device or entitlement activation without verified service evidence.

audit_findings.title: Production implementation baseline
audit_findings.required_outcome: Java/Spring/PostgreSQL runtime, locked supported BOM, production API/migrations/RLS and deployment pipeline absent; Python harness cannot certify architecture compliance.

audit_findings.title: Provider settlement must use unified finance engine
audit_findings.required_outcome: Verified successful provider response must run the same open-period, allocation/credit/deposit and balanced-journal settlement helper as other payments. If funds are verified but accounting cannot post, retain review-required state and never charge again.
audit_findings.state: Reported to mobile-money and root agents; integration pending
audit_findings.resolution: MTN reconciliation invokes finance allocation and posting under SAVEPOINT; closed-period evidence retained for review. Simulated-provider tests pass.
